qrcode-generator 1.4.4, by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licensed.

  https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

Served from this site rather than from cdnjs for the same reason the fonts are: the landing and the
playground are published standalone as well as from here, and a page that draws a QR code to
demonstrate offline verification should not need somebody else's CDN to draw it.

Unmodified. The pages still guard with `typeof qrcode === 'undefined'` and say so on screen if it
does not load, because a demo that silently shows nothing is worse than one that admits it.
